title: Contract Pricing Agreement Scope of the Stock-Rotation Purchase Base
content:
For a stock-rotation return on a Ship-To Fulfillment Account, the merchandise that makes up the rotation purchase base depends on the level of the customer's active Contract Pricing Agreement.

**Rule.** The rotation purchase base follows the customer's active Contract Pricing Agreement: under a Corbett Category Contract it is only the ship-to's shipped and filled merchandise whose product category is that of the rotation item, within the 12 months; under a Corbett Net-Price Contract or a Corbett Cost-Plus Contract it is only the ship-to's shipped and filled merchandise of the rotation item's item number, within the 24 months before the request date.

Under any other agreement, or with no active agreement, the purchase base is not narrowed by this rule.

### Reading the records

- The agreement is the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement whose status is active; its level is the agreement level shown on it (Corbett Category Contract, Corbett Net-Price Contract, Corbett Cost-Plus Contract, or another level).
- *Shipped and filled merchandise* is the extended amount of the ship-to's shipped order lines and backorder fill lines.
- The rotation item's product category is the product category of the shipped order line being rotated; its item number is the Corbett item number of that line.
- A line is within N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from the request date; whole months are the difference in calendar months, less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller than that of the earlier date.

### Decision table

| Active agreement level | Merchandise in the purchase base | Window |
|---|---|---|
| Corbett Category Contract | the rotation item's product category only | 12 months |
| Corbett Net-Price Contract or Corbett Cost-Plus Contract | the rotation item's item number only | 24 months |
| any other level, or no active agreement | not narrowed by this rule | not changed by this rule |

*Hypothetical case:* under a Corbett Net-Price Contract, a ship-to whose shipped and filled merchandise of the rotated item number totals 1800.00 in the 24 months before the request date counts 1800.00 of shipped and filled merchandise in its purchase base; its shipped and filled merchandise of other item numbers is not counted.
